sources.title: Instructions for Form 1120-S, U.S. Income Tax Return for an S Corporation
tags: retrievalInstructions:Fetch the current-year instructions; capture 'When To File', extension rules, and Schedule K-1 furnishing deadline. Record the tax year the instructions cover.

sources.title: About Form 941, Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture quarterly filing due dates and deposit schedule references (monthly vs semiweekly). Follow the link to the instructions for the current revision.

sources.title: About Form 940, Employer's Annual Federal Unemployment (FUTA) Tax Return
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the annual due date, FUTA rate, wage base and credit-reduction notes from the instructions.

sources.title: Publication 15 (Circular E), Employer's Tax Guide
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the Social Security rate and wage base, Medicare rate and additional Medicare threshold, and deposit rules for the tax year. Record the publication year.

sources.title: S Corporation Compensation and Medical Insurance Issues
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the reasonable-compensation factors verbatim. This page supports professional judgment only; it never yields a number.

sources.title: Instructions for Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture who must receive a 1099-NEC, the reporting threshold, and the furnishing/filing due dates for the tax year.

sources.title: About Form W-9, Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture when a W-9 is requested from a US payee and retention expectations.

sources.title: About Form W-8 BEN, Certificate of Foreign Status of Beneficial Owner
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture when a W-8BEN applies to a foreign individual payee and its validity period. Which form applies to a given worker is a CPA/attorney decision.

sources.title: Estimated Taxes (corporations and individuals)
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the individual and corporate estimated payment schedule. Owner personal estimates are OUT OF SCOPE for the business system; store only as a reminder.

sources.title: Publication 463, Travel, Gift, and Car Expenses
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the meals deductibility percentage, substantiation requirements (amount, time, place, business purpose, attendees) and per-diem references for the tax year.

sources.title: Publication 946, How To Depreciate Property
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture Section 179 limits, bonus depreciation percentage and MACRS class lives for the tax year. Tax depreciation elections are CPA decisions.

sources.title: Publication 583, Starting a Business and Keeping Records
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the recordkeeping guidance and the 'how long to keep records' table for the retention policy defaults.

sources.title: Publication 587, Business Use of Your Home
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the exclusive-use and principal-place-of-business tests and the simplified method rate. Added because the home_office_rules tax rule needs it.

sources.title: Form 100S, California S Corporation Franchise or Income Tax Return (booklet)
tags: retrievalInstructions:Search the FTB forms index for the current-year 100S booklet; capture 'When to file', automatic extension and payment rules.

sources.title: S corporations — franchise tax rate and minimum franchise tax
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the S corporation franchise tax rate and the minimum franchise tax amount plus first-year exemptions. Never restate these numbers from memory.

sources.title: Estimated tax payments for corporations
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the corporate estimated payment installment schedule and minimum-tax first-installment rules.

sources.title: Required filings and due dates (DE 9 / DE 9C)
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture DE 9 / DE 9C quarterly due dates and deposit (DE 88) frequency rules.

sources.title: Rates and withholding (UI, ETT, SDI)
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the UI new-employer rate and taxable wage limit, ETT rate, and SDI rate/wage limit for the tax year.

sources.title: Am I required to register as an employer?
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the registration threshold and timing for California employers.

sources.title: State Disability Insurance — employer requirements
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture employer obligations for SDI withholding and notices.

sources.title: Statement of Information filing requirements (LLC)
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the LLC filing cadence (biennial), the filing window relative to the formation month, and the fee.

sources.title: Employee or Independent Contractor Classification Under the FLSA
tags: retrievalInstructions:Capture the current economic-reality test factors. Supports professional judgment only; the system never classifies workers.
